facts.fact: The World Bank's procurement plan for the Accountable Governance for Basic Service Delivery project, revised 30 June 2026, lists the Ministry of Finance's hiring of a service provider to provide internet services for the local councils, to facilitate the implementation of PFM Smart, estimated at US$75,000: contract signed 12 August 2025 and shown as completed on 18 November 2025; it does not say how many councils are served or whether the service runs on after the contract's completion.
facts.system: Internet services for the local councils for PFM Smart

facts.fact: The procurement plan's line for internet services for the local councils, signed 12 August 2025 and completed 18 November 2025, gives no count of the councils provided with the service and no total.
facts.system: Internet services for the local councils for PFM Smart

facts.fact: The internet services for the local councils were procured by the Ministry of Finance, the project's implementing agency, by request for quotations on the national market, with the contract signed on 12 August 2025.

facts.fact: The internet services contract for the local councils, estimated at US$75,000 and signed 12 August 2025, is charged to World Bank grant IDA D8380 under the project's component 1; the plan names no domestic budget line.

facts.fact: The contract for internet services for the local councils to facilitate PFM Smart, signed 12 August 2025, is shown as completed on 18 November 2025, ahead of a planned 26 February 2026.

note: A procurement plan: it gives contract lines, amounts and dates and nothing of what was working at a council. The internet line states that the service was procured for the councils and the contract completed; it does not state that any council was working in PFM Smart. The dates are read from the plan's planned and actual columns, which the extracted text runs together; the PFM Smart contract's signature date is not read with confidence and is given as the year only.
